purpose: Fixed-observation block-level selective full-teacher correction using disagreement between two frozen student checkpoints.

selection_and_banks.banks: frozen-start anchor-aligned step3000 student-driven CEM; teacher shadow labels; shared within each paired set

cem_collection.selection_operator: torch.topk(cost, k=30, largest=False), matching pinned stable-worldmodel LeWM solver

uncertainty_rule.ranking: torch.topk(student_cost, k=30, largest=False, sorted=True).indices; pinned LeWM solver semantics
uncertainty_rule.sentinel_role: uncertainty_only; never used to select the returned action
uncertainty_rule.global_rank_disagreement: secondary report only; never combined with u, thresholded, or used in a sweep

threshold_calibration.set: midpoints between adjacent distinct calibration u levels
threshold_calibration.call_rule: call full teacher iff u > tau
threshold_calibration.selection_rule: retain candidates with 0 < calibration call rate <=0.25 and choose the candidate with maximum calibration call rate; if tied choose the largest tau
threshold_calibration.discrete_tie_policy: midpoint tau makes the strict u>tau rule include all equal-u blocks without block-ID tie breaking

uncertainty_rule.random_baseline: analytic same-budget expectation; no Monte Carlo seed
uncertainty_rule.random_baseline_rule: for each episode with m selective calls, expected random episode mean regret=(1-m/18)*main episode mean regret

test_policy.uncertain: compute full teacher on the same 300-candidate bank and return exact teacher top30

metrics.standardized_regret: (teacher mean cost of returned top30 - teacher mean cost of teacher top30) / max(population std of teacher costs, 1e-6)
metrics.primary_aggregation: episode mean over 18 trajectory blocks, then median across 8 episodes
metrics.reported_distribution: episode median, episode p90, block median, block p90, and each CEM round
metrics.risk_capture: fraction of test blocks with main regret >=1.5 that receive a teacher call

timing.scope: all 144 test trajectory blocks (8 episodes x 3 anchors x 2 seeds x 3 rounds)
timing.measurement: perf_counter wall time bracketed by CUDA synchronize; include candidate H2D, two-student scoring, uncertainty, teacher300 and top30 selection
timing.teacher_only: full teacher rollout on 300 candidates plus teacher top30 selection
timing.state_goal_cache: same GPU-cached latent/state/goal preparation across timing arms

gates.failure_action: STOP; no adaptive CEM or closed-loop follow-up

scope.gpu_telemetry: job.log direct nvidia-smi PID every 5 seconds
